g.text: Segment exports - CSV/Parquet artifacts via report jobs
Portal CSV/TSV upload - small files, PII hashed client-side
Gateway /v1/api/audiences - JSON + multipart CSV/TSV, match rate per upload
Minio drop-zone adtech-onboarding/<provider>/ - csv/tsv/parquet, zip/gzip auto-detected
2 - behavioural rules (pure-Go over the Delta reader) + reconcile
3 - enroll person, expand to every id in cluster
DSP unions dsp_private + audience bid modifiers price bids
ad request - user_id, uid2, hashed_email, ifa, IP->household, page context
behaviour.observed - consented at capture, category stamped at event time
lake copy of uploads (batched via NATS)
